name: Legacy (previous app): single mark 0-10 per trick, best 3 + Variety 0-10, 7 attempts
description: Reproduces the model used in the owner's previous competition app (KOL 26 U16): judges give one mark 0-10 per trick (average shown), the best 3 tricks count, plus one Variety mark 0-10 per rider per heat; each rider has 7 attempts per heat; crashes are logged with the intended trick and score nothing. Scales confirmed by the owner on 29 Sep 2026 (step 0.5 assumed; the step is editable per event in the event wizard, e.g. whole numbers or 0.1). Heat total 0-40.
basedOn: kite-comp-judging.vercel.app public leaderboard and bracket + owner's description, 29 Sep 2026

impression.label: Variety
impression.help: How varied the rider's landed tricks were across the heat (direction, rotations, board-offs, handle).
